pulse.endpoint_details_note: Strict NativeLiExample.native_event does not expose rejected endpoint details; private supervisor diagnostics are separate.

calibration.adc_convention: floor(V/LSB); reconstruct (code+0.5)*LSB; threshold inclusive; saturation at V>=10.0 V; 14-bit peak ADC

settings.seed_rule: SHA256(seed/global_event_id/raw_row_index/parcel_index), first8 bytes big-endian UInt64; no chunk/group index
